blockingLoop.evidence: Asked 'check the lint filter' in turns 1, 2 and 3 despite customer twice saying 'haven't checked', but progress continued

rationale: The assistant immediately steered away from the heater hypothesis toward load size, correctly weighted the 9kg-vs-6kg mismatch once stated, endorsed high spin, and concluded 'simply an overloading issue' with 'without needing any repairs' after the half-load test came out dry - matching the hidden truth. Weaknesses are repeatedly asking the customer to check the lint filter/condenser across three turns after being told it had not been checked, and asserting filter/condenser locations ('lint filter in the door opening', 'condenser unit behind the bottom flap') that are doubtful for this Samsung model. Safety handling (unplug first) and calibration ('probably', then firmer after confirmatory test) were appropriate, and no parts or escalation were suggested.
